cells:
  shapes
    out:    shapes: List<IShape>
    uses types
  areas
    in:     shapes: List<IShape> <- shapes
    out:    areas: List<Area>
    uses types
  largest
    in:     areas: List<Area> <- areas
    out:    largest: Area
    uses types
edges:
  shapes -> types
  areas -> shapes [shapes]
  areas -> types
  largest -> areas [areas]
  largest -> types
downstream:
  shapes: areas, largest
  areas: largest
  largest: 
  types: shapes, areas, largest
